title: Orchestrating Long-Running Workflows
description: Coordinate a multi-day approval and fulfilment process that must survive restarts and wait for humans.

data.text: An onboarding workflow must: call a credit-check API, wait for a human manager to approve (usually hours, sometimes days), provision three systems, then email the result. Current implementation is a saga of queue messages with a status column in SQL, and a server restart has stranded eleven workflows mid-flight. Redesign it.

Use **Durable Functions** (the orchestrator pattern) so workflow state is persisted automatically at every `await` and the process can be replayed after a restart or redeploy. Model human approval as an **external event** with a timeout — never as a polling loop or a `Thread.Sleep`. The orchestrator stays deterministic; all I/O goes in **activity functions**.

data.title: Orchestrator with human approval and timeout
Raise the approval event from the API

data.text: A workflow that waits days cannot live in a process, a thread, or an HTTP request. Durable Functions persist a **history of decisions** and replay it, so the orchestrator can be unloaded between steps and resumed on any instance. External events make human steps first-class, and timers handle deadlines without polling.
